# Claudock

> Claudock is a free, open-source (MIT) desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that opens the Claude Code config folder (~/.claude, or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) and the MCP servers in ~/.claude.json, with one screen for each part. Run it with `npx claudock` (Node.js 22.12 or later). It is unofficial and not affiliated with Anthropic.

Screens: Today (5-hour and weekly limits exactly as Claude Code reports them, else token counts from transcripts; running and waiting sessions; today's sessions; this week's activity), Settings (settings.json and settings.local.json as a form or raw JSON, with history), CLAUDE.md & rules, Hooks, Permissions, Skills (turn on or off through skillOverrides, edit, duplicate), Agents, Commands, Plugins, Mods, MCP servers, Projects (session transcripts), Memory, Plans, History, Storage (disk use with cleanup suggestions) and Backups (diff and restore snapshots).

A menu bar item (a tray icon on Windows and Linux) shows the limit and a dot while a session waits for you; one alert fires when a session starts waiting. "Connect to Claude Code" (macOS and Linux) adds a status line step and session hooks for this; Disconnect removes them, leaving settings.json byte for byte as it was if nothing else changed it. First launch shows 26 weeks of activity from Claude Code's stats-cache.json, with a Share card.

Every write is preceded by a snapshot kept outside ~/.claude, then done with a temp file and a rename; JSON is validated first; deletes go to the OS Trash. It never reads .credentials.json or sessions/*.key. It doesn't run, update or sign in to Claude Code, doesn't sync between machines, and doesn't edit the .claude/ folders inside repositories. It has no telemetry and no account.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/behkha/claudock/blob/main/README.md): what it does, install, first-launch steps for the unsigned installers
- [Security](https://github.com/behkha/claudock/blob/main/SECURITY.md): what it reads, never reads and sends, and how to report a problem
- [Development](https://github.com/behkha/claudock/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): setup, the fixture rule, code layout
- [Privacy](https://behkha.github.io/claudock/privacy/): network requests made by the app and the website

## Comparisons

- [Claude Code GUIs in 2026](https://behkha.github.io/claudock/alternatives/claude-code-gui/): Claudock, Claude Code's own apps, CC Switch, opcode, ccusage and Claude Code Usage Monitor
- [Claudock vs opcode](https://behkha.github.io/claudock/compare/opcode/)
- [Claudock vs CC Switch](https://behkha.github.io/claudock/compare/cc-switch/)
- [ccusage with a GUI](https://behkha.github.io/claudock/alternatives/ccusage-gui/): desktop apps that show Claude Code tokens, cost and limits
